title: Downtown Nashville Oasis: Vibrant 1BR Apt w/ Pool
description:
Welcome to our vibrant downtown Nashville getaway! Just a 10-minute stroll from Broadway. This cozy and spacious 1-bedroom apartment is perfect for up to 5 guests. Enjoy a king-sized bed, a pull-out queen sofa, and an air mattress. The apartment includes free parking, two smart TVs, free high-speed WiFi, an in-unit washer and dryer, and a balcony. The stocked kitchen includes dishware, cooking utensils, and a dual Keurig for your convenience.

The space
📱 KEYLESS ENTRY via Door app and Self Check-in

🏋🏼TWO-STORY FITNESS CENTER with a rock climbing wall & private yoga room

🏊🏼 RESORT-STYLE POOL with private cabanas (open year round)

🌞 OUTDOOR COURTYARD with grills, firepits, covered gazebo, and lots of seating to relax and unwind

💻 TWO-STORY COLLECTIVE on 1st floor- perfect for entertaining or co-working

🌇 ELEVATED 6th FLOOR SKY LOUNGE & DECK with city views- perfect spot for Golden Hour

🛜 HIGH SPEED WI-FI in unit and common areas to stay connected

📸 INSTA-WORTHY- Several photo ops throughout community to capture moments and memories

With on-site maintenance, concierge, and security, plus easy access to Uber/Lyft and other ride share services, your stay is worry-free.

Building amenities are available but beyond our control, and we assume no responsibility for their maintenance, noise or availability. By booking, you acknowledge this disclaimer.

Guest access
All occupants must be listed on the reservation.

NO UNAUTHORIZED GUESTS are allowed, NO PETS, and  only authorized guests receive access to property amenities (managed by property management).

Other things to note
The apartment is centrally located, making it easy to reach the Nashville International Airport in 10-15 minutes.

📍 Broadway- 10 min walk
📍 Bridgestone Arena- 8 min walk
📍 Music City Center- 6 min walk
📍 Country Music Hall of Fame- 4 min walk
📍 The Ryman Auditorium- 10 min walk
📍 Ascend Amphitheater- 0.6 mi (or quick rideshare)
📍 Nissan Stadium- 1.4 mi (or quick rideshare)

🚗 If you are booking a rental vehicle, contact us for a discount through National, Enterprise, or Alamo!
